title: gentiana rubicunda subsp. biloba
intro: Gentiana rubicunda subsp. biloba, commonly known as a variant of the Gentian plant species, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Gentianaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Gentiana rubicunda subsp. biloba include its ability to stimulate digestion, improve appetite, and alleviate symptoms of fever and cough. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, such as gentiopicroside and swertiamarin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
